mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.gender, d.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, d.title, d.specialty, d.introduction, d.avatar, d.phone, d.status FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.gender, d.department_id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, d.title, d.specialty, d.introduction, d.avatar, d.phone, d.status FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_id = #{deptId} AND d.status = 1
